scheme_name: Shramyogi Cycle Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The applicant must have been employed for the last one year in a factory or institute in Gujarat.
The applicant must be a regular contributor to the Labour Welfare Fund.
The scheme can be availed only once during the employment period.
Assistance is provided only for a newly purchased bicycle.
The application must be made within six months from the date on the bicycle purchase bill.
The bicycle purchase bill must include the beneficiary’s name, the shopkeeper’s GST number, and the cycle chassis number, and the chassis size must be at least 22 inches.
The final decision on assistance rests with the Welfare Commissioner in Ahmedabad.
benefits_summary: Labourers receive a subsidy of ₹1,500 towards the purchase of a bicycle.
